summary:
Revised feature roadmap and implementation plan based strictly on the user's selected features:
- Cash tender & change calculator with quick denomination buttons and UX polish in POS checkout.
- Quick 'Sold Out' availability toggle, +5/+10 batch restock buttons, and cost price margin tracking in inventory.
- Order cancellation with recorded reason and automatic stock replenishment in Sales History / Orders.
- End-of-day cash drawer closing summary, best-selling items leaderboard, and 1-tap WhatsApp/text summary sharing in reports.
